commit.message:
Switch to the newly added account when logging in

addLogin appends to the end of the logins array, but the current user
is logins[0]. So when an already-logged-in user opened "Add another
account" and chose any login method, the new account silently landed
at the back of the queue while the prior account remained current.

Most damaging on the signup path through SetupQuestionnaire: ProfileStep
and FollowsStep publish via useNostrPublish, which signs as
useCurrentUser().user. With no auto-switch, the new account's kind 0
metadata overwrote the previous user's profile, and FollowsStep merged
the curated follow pack into the previous user's kind 3 contact list.

- useLoginActions: wrap each addLogin in addAndActivate, which also
  calls setLogin(login.id) to promote the new login to logins[0]. Fixes
  every login path (nsec / bunker / extension / nostrconnect), not just
  signup.
- InitialSyncGate: defensive guards in ProfileStep.handlePublishProfile
  and FollowsStep.handleFollowAll that verify the active signer matches
  the just-generated nsec before publishing kind 0 / kind 3; refuse and
  toast otherwise. Belt and suspenders against any future regression in
  the switch logic.
- Add a targeted regression test for the auto-switch behavior.

Regression-of: 1d967b98d0c75b5bc270661712669ebce285bc42
